summary: Backend + Frontend verified for new Mar-2026+ auto guard and Manual (year>=2000) rules. Backend: 13/13 pytest PASS — auto guard rejects Feb-2026 and Dec-2025 with detail containing 'March 2026' and 'Manual Salary Slip'; current month (Jul-2026) and future year still blocked; auto success Mar-2026 (letter_title 'Salary Slip - Mar-2026'), Jun-2026 (letter_title 'Salary Slip - Jun-2026') both return pdf_base64; sandwich_days=4.0 for Milan Jul-2026 regression intact; manual endpoint success for 2019-05 (letter_title 'Salary Slip - May-2019 (Manual)') and 2015-06 (letter_title 'Salary Slip - Jun-2015 (Manual)'); manual guards year<2000 → 400 with '2000', current month (2026-07) → 400, future year → 400; offer_letter /api/documents/generate still responds 200/400 (no 500). Frontend: login OK, /admin/employee/1 Documents tab month dropdown correctly disables 8 months (Jan, Feb, Jul-Dec) for year=2026 leaving only Mar-Jun enabled, default y=2026 m=6, helper text contains both 'Mar 2026' and 'Manual Salary Slip'; Generate flow works. /admin/manual-salary-slip: year options 2015..2026 (12 entries) ✓, manual-emp-picker has 98 options with optgroups ['Active', 'Ex-Employees / Inactive'] ✓, picking Milan (id=1) prefills manual-emp-name='MILAN TANDEL', manual-company-name='Zestbrains ICICI', manual-basic-p='32500', manual-pt='200' ✓; changing to y=2019 m=5 + clicking manual-generate-btn downloads 'MILAN TANDEL_Salary Slip - May-2019 (Manual).pdf' ✓.

ui_bugs.issue: Year <select data-testid=salary-slip-year> renders options 2021..2026 (6 options). Per revised spec (Auto restricted to Mar-2026+), year list should only contain [2026]. Auto guard on backend blocks any pre-Mar-2026 selection so it is not functionally broken, but the UI still allows selecting 2021-2025 which then only shows disabled months. Requirement says 'year dropdown min = 2026' — code at /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/EmployeeDetail.js:581 uses `Array.from({length: currentDate.getFullYear() - 2021 + 1}, ...)` and should start from AUTO_MIN_Y (2026) instead of 2021.

issues: Carried over: shadcn DialogContent still missing aria-describedby (non-blocking a11y warning).

action_items: Change year options in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/EmployeeDetail.js line 581 from `Array.from({length: currentDate.getFullYear() - 2021 + 1}, (_, i) => 2021 + i)` to start at AUTO_MIN_Y (2026) so only 2026 (and forward) show up. Currently the dropdown offers 2021-2025 which are effectively unusable (all months locked).
critical_code_review_comments: EmployeeDetail year list not aligned with AUTO_MIN_Y — hardcoded 2021 constant; should derive from AUTO_MIN_Y.
ManualSalarySlip.js handleEmployeeSelect refetches employees/banks/departments on every pick; consider caching in useEffect on mount instead of per-selection.

Server /api/documents/salary-slip guard order: (year,month)<(2026,3) check happens before current/future — good. But error messages diverge (auto detail mentions Manual page path, manual detail says '2000 or later'). Keep this consistent for the frontend to lookup via error code.
